Chapter 6994: Fantian Progenitor

Chapter 6994: Fantian Progenitor

The figures exuded imperial and ancestral auras. These were the strongest cultivators of Fantian Dynasty.

“Who are you? Please leave.” An emperor raised his voice.

“All of you need to leave now, this is not where you should stay.” Li Qiye said.

Listeners’ expression soured after listening to the mortal. However, a mortal couldn’t have survived the guards’ attacks.

“We’ll see what you can do!” An ancient ancestor summoned an energy sword that continued to grow in size.

After a roar, he commanded it to perform a vertical slash, cutting through buildings and pavilions.

“Bam!” Something invisible blocked the slash three inches away from Li Qiye.

The ancient ancestor mustered all of his strength to no avail, unable to finish the strike to the crowd’s astonishment.

Next, the sword crumbled while the opponent didn’t move an inch.

“You’re courting death staying here.” Li Qiye said.

Although the group was afraid, they didn’t retreat from their ancestral ground. This was the source of their dynasty.

“Kill him!” They summoned their weapons, unable to abandon their oath. Auras surged and refined the space around Li Qiye.

The dynasty became determined to slay the invader.

“Fireflies.” Li Qiye waved his hand gently, crushing all the attacks and sending them flying.

“Ugh...” All of them felt as if a hammer had just smashed their chest. They soared through mountains and peaks, leaving behind deep holes and cracks.

“An immortal?” An emperor shuddered.

Recently, they felt the presence of numerous immortals in Dusk Realm. However, these immortals only focused on the visual phenomena and didn’t care about the inhabitants.

Thus, they were still fine after the evacuation until now. They thought Li Qiye must be an immortal despite his appearance. Just a single one was enough to obliterate them.

“Creak.” A gate opened within their ancestral ground. Sword energy oozed out and engulfed the kingdom, capable of cutting down stars.

“The progenitor!” They became ecstatic, hoping the progenitor would be enough to save their ancestral ground.

“What is it?” A woman spoke with a firm and clear tone.

“Progenitor.” Everyone prostrated to show reverence.

Li Qiye also stared at her - a young woman who gave no thought to her attire, unadorned with stylistic choices and loose enough to hide her figure.

Judging on looks alone, she was definitely a kingdom-toppling beauty. However, she cared not about her appearance - barefaced without any makeup. Her long hair was casually tied in a ponytail. She looked disheveled, more like a wild boy than a peerless beauty.

Thus, her clothes and temperament didn’t match her flawless features. Others would consider this rebellious. Nevertheless, this unrestrained freedom gave her a unique and transcendent style.

Li Qiye couldn’t help but smile after seeing her.

“Progenitor, a foreign immortal is invading us, please help.” The crowd placed their hope on her.
